project_stage: Step 11 - AI vs Manual/CLT Comparison Backend
purpose: Compare ANN tensile-strength prediction and CLT strain-allowable result only when both describe the same physical laminate case and can be expressed as the same engineering quantity.

prohibited_changes: Do not retrain ANN for Step 11.
Do not add stacking_sequence to current ANN inputs.
Do not modify preprocessing or saved model artifact.

clt_system.lambda_cs_description: Dimensionless load factor from source-compatible strain allowable route. It scales the supplied CLT load vector.

source_material.name: TU Delft / Zenodo source-backed lamina card

reference_validation.meaning: TU Delft reference vs local CLT implementation only; not ANN vs CLT.

prohibited_changes: Do not alter CLT equations for Step 11 unless a real bug is discovered.
Do not treat Nx as MPa.

comparison_case.material_compatibility_policy: Direct comparison requires explicit evidence that ANN sample material/process data and CLT material card represent the same physical material system. ANN category names alone are not sufficient.

allowed_when: CLT load case is uniaxial tensile Nx > 0
Ny, Nxy, Mx, My, and Mxy are zero
ply thickness and ply count are known
equivalent_laminate_tensile_stress_mpa.clt_equation: failure_Nx_N_per_m = lambda_cs * base_Nx_N_per_m; CLT_common_value_MPa = failure_Nx_N_per_m / total_thickness_m / 1e6

allowed_when: ANN tensile strength is treated as average laminate tensile stress for the verified same material case

difference_calculation.allowed_only_when: Both common values represent the same physical quantity and same units.
difference_calculation.label: Relative difference from CLT

comparison_prohibited_when: ANN output is tensile strength MPa but CLT output remains raw lambda_cs
base load unit is not N/m
load case is compression, biaxial, shear, or bending
CLT lambda_cs is missing or non-finite
